name: Sierra
description: Builds customer-facing conversational agents with a declarative Agent SDK, guardrails, and an Agent OS runtime spanning voice, chat, email, and SMS.

skills.name: Declarative Agent Definition
skills.description: Describes agent behavior, tools, and escalation paths in a declarative language rather than hand-written prompts.

skills.name: Guardrails
skills.description: Constrains what an agent may say and do so customer-facing conversations stay inside policy boundaries.

skills.name: Omnichannel Delivery
skills.description: Runs the same agent across voice, chat, email, and SMS with channel-appropriate behavior on each surface.
